info.title: Isomux Website API
info.description: Public API served by isomux.com. Self-hosted office APIs are documented by each office and in the Isomux source route table.

post.description: Answer a question about Isomux, with optional documentation context supplied by the caller.

200.description: Server-sent event stream. Each data frame contains a text delta; the final frame is [DONE].

content.description: Must contain a character other than whitespace. Lengths count UTF-16 code units, so a character such as an emoji counts as two.

messages.description: The conversation, oldest first. Roles alternate, starting and ending with user. The contents hold at most 48,000 characters in total. A request body over 1,000,000 bytes, or over these limits, gets 413.

pageContext.description: Optional documentation context. The server uses at most the first 20,000 characters.

page.description: Page where the visitor opened the chat widget.

conversationId.description: Optional id that groups the requests of one conversation in the server log. The server ignores a value that does not match ^[a-z0-9]{8,32}$.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The request quotas per client IP, as in the IETF draft draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers: "minute";q=5;w=60, "hour";q=20;w=3600. q is the number of requests and w the window in seconds; both windows slide.

RateLimit.description: Where the client stands in each policy of RateLimit-Policy (IETF draft draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers): r is the remaining requests and t the seconds until the oldest counted request leaves that window. Requests other than POST are not counted.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed.

JsonError.description: Structured error with a stable code and recovery hint.

RateLimited.description: A request quota is spent. Wait the Retry-After seconds before the next request.
